title: Auto Feeder User's Manual
body_html:
Introduction

Automatic Conveyor Feeder is designed for OneLaser X series to feed materials automatically , enabling machine to process longer materials .

Safety first ( important )

Read and get familiar with all safety precautions and measures before using this product . Strictly follow all safety precautions . Ensure that this product is properly assembled and is working properly .

Follow the operating principles :

  • Turn off OneLaser X series before connecting Automatic Conveyor Feeder connection cable to machine .
  • Do not let any body part to approach the Automatic Conveyor Feeder while the machine or Automatic Conveyor Feeder is running .
  • Every times before processing with Automatic Conveyor Feeder , make sure material moving direction have no items blocking the material .
  • Always follow OneLaser X series user manual instructions during using Automatic Conveyor Feeder .

Use the Automatic Conveyor Feeder

Notes:

  • Before using the Automatic Conveyor Feeder , make sure it ' s assembled by “ Assembly Instructions for Automatic Conveyor Feeder”.
  • Instructions for use can be found in this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lob4UFA0F6E&t=32s

Cautions

  • Ensure that you use flat materials without warping edges .
  • Adjust the distance between the rails according to the width of the material to be processed . To prevent material distortion and pattern deformation , ensure that each part of the material is pressed as evenly as possible .

Preparecation working

1. Plug rotary cable to machine and turn on the rotary switch .

2. Turn on machine main power .

3. Turn the upper knob counterclockwise to raise the pinch rollers .

4. Feed the material into the Automatic Conveyor Feeder . Align the material with the grids on the Automatic Conveyor Feeder .

5. Turn the upper knob clockwise to lower the pinch rollers to press the material in place.

6. You can rotate the lower knob to slightly adjust the position of the material if needed.

7. Follow the instructions “Using Automatic Conveyor Feeder with LightBurn” .
